periods.description: Surviving old empire loyalists who infiltrate or gather outside the New Kingdom and attempt to restore imperial power.
periods.history: After the empire's fall, surviving Drag-Knights and sympathizers hid among neighboring supporters or within the New Kingdom military. Belbet's force reveals itself in volume 1.
periods.goals: Restore the Arcadia Empire, capture or kill Lisha, threaten the capital, and use Abyss and military force to destabilize the New Kingdom.
periods.structure: Hidden commanders such as Belbet, infiltrated guard personnel, and a reserve force of gray imperial Drag-Rides.
